## What you're trying to build

## How you work around it today

<!--
  This is the most useful part of the report. A workaround shows where the framework
  forces boilerplate, and how much. If there is no workaround, say that instead.
-->

## Which module it belongs to

<!--
  Your best guess is fine. If it spans modules or belongs in the core, say so - that
  distinction usually decides whether the capability is worth generalising at all.
-->

## Why the framework rather than your application

<!--
  Being reusable in principle is not the bar. Something earns a place in the framework
  when more than one consumer needs it, or when doing it wrong is dangerous enough that
  a correct default is worth shipping.
-->
